description: memory.md and storage-engines.md each independently state the same two minimum memory-to-data ratios (Couchstore 10%, Magma 1%) in near-identical wording ('minimum memory-to-data ratio of 10%' versus 'recommended to be at least 10% of your expected dataset size'), restated rather than cross-referenced. These are sizing figures an operator budgets against; if either is revised in only one place the two pages will disagree about a number with hardware cost attached.
